# Budibase

> > Budibase is a low-code platform for building internal tools and AI agents that automate business operations with drag-and-drop builders and data integration.

Budibase enables organizations to rapidly create custom internal applications, approval workflows, and automated business processes. The platform features AI agents powered by Mistral 3, extensive data integration capabilities, and pre-built templates for IT operations, serving customers including the Bulgarian Government, Schnellecke, Ströer-x, and Herrenknecht.

## Key Topics

- Low-code development
- AI agents and automation
- Internal tools and applications
- Workflow automation
- Approval workflows
- Business operations
- Data integration
- Drag-and-drop builder
- IT templates
- Request management
- Customer case studies
- Slack and Gmail integration
- Enterprise customers
- Mistral 3 AI
- Business process automation
